items: Mochatrade raises $5.5M for perpetual futures on US stocks
Crypto-style perps on Nvidia, Tesla, Apple for Indian traders, up to 50× leverage, funded over UPI — a regulatory question waiting to be asked.
Karta AI raises $3M for AI agents on complex inbound calls
Built by two ex-Razorpay executives, aimed at lenders' and insurers' multi-step customer calls.
NPCI defers the UPI merchant charge two days before launch
The 0.4% P2M charge due 15 Oct is postponed with no new date; festive season cited.
Insurance brokers say IRDAI's overhaul could cut revenue 70%
Broker commissions rose 173% over FY23–25 against 37% premium growth — the regulator's case in one number.
Zomint raises ₹36 cr to turn a YouTube audience into MF clients
Every client so far came from the co-founder's finance channel — distribution as content.
Desible.ai raises ₹32 cr for compliant voice agents at banks
Collections, renewals and claims calls for 40+ banks, NBFCs and insurers.
Razorpay will sell ads inside ChatGPT for Indian brands
Launch categories include jewellery, insurance, matchmaking and education.
UPI processed 24.07 B transactions in September
Monthly dip is the 30-day calendar; daily volume set a record.
Seeds Fincap raises ₹100 cr equity for micro-business lending
₹1,092 cr issue drew ₹77,843 cr of bids, two weeks after the fresh issue was cut.
Supreme Court declines to stay the UPI charge rollout
Notices issued to the Centre, RBI and NPCI asking for the legal basis.
IRDAI proposes capping insurance commissions; PB Fintech falls 36%
ICICI Lombard rose 5% the same day — distributors lose, carriers gain.
Mastercard sells its entire Pine Labs stake for ₹934 cr
Domestic insurers and mutual funds took the shares.
PayGlocal gets IFSCA approval for a GIFT City payments arm
Adds to its RBI cross-border aggregator licence and US FinCEN registration.
Safebox raises $1.11M to map what Indian families own
Pitched against ₹86,917 cr of unclaimed bank deposits.
Finance costs outran interest income; NII up about 15%.
Moneyview halves its IPO fresh issue to ₹750 cr
Accel, Tiger Global and Ribbit cut secondary sales; founders kept theirs.
Kissht's parent weighs another fundraise four months after its IPO
Loan book grew 61% — the IPO money didn't last; board considering preferential issue or private placement.
Piston raises $15M for a US fuel network built from Kolkata
American company, American customers — every engineer in Kolkata; the play is bypassing card networks entirely.
Fundly.ai raises $4M from existing backers, three years after its seed
Insider round with headcount down ~20% — pivoting from lending into commerce.
Slice raises at $450M — down from a $1.5B peak, and profitable
Half the round is secondaries; priced as a bank now, not a fintech.
UPI moved less money in August than July — on 850M more transactions
Record 24.51B volume, value slipped to ₹29.82 L cr; the average ticket keeps shrinking.
Vecton AI raises ₹6 cr pre-seed led by Zeropearl VC
Compliant AI systems for banks and insurers, forward-deployed engineering model.
super.money launches superGift with Flipkart, Myntra, Cleartrip
Multi-brand gifting; Razorpay and Pine Labs power redemption.
